bio: Galloping straight out of a ghost story, woe betide any who fall in the sights of Grimnall's pistols. Run! Hide! Cower if you must! But once you're marked by this pumpkin-headed rider, he and his terrifying undead steed, conjured from the foulest night terrors, Biscuits, will chase you to the world's end and back.
